summary: EdAdvance, a Connecticut Regional Educational Service Center, opposes several proposed E‑Rate changes that would cut funding for Head Start/pre‑K programs, reverse the educational‑purpose presumption, impose a rural/poverty screen, and require all contracts to be signed after the 28‑day waiting period. EdAdvance urges the FCC to adopt an exception for State Master contracts and preserve eligibility of existing competitively procured multi‑year contracts, arguing that doing so prevents unnecessary cost increases and protects responsible districts.
